description: Create LVM2 information dumps for diagnostic purposes.

option.name: -a
tip: Advanced collection (may hang if LVM is already hung).

option.name: -d
tip: Dump into a directory instead of a tarball.

option.name: -l
tip: Include lvmetad daemon state if running.

option.name: -m
tip: Gather LVM metadata from the PVs.

option.name: -p
tip: Include lvmpolld daemon state if running.
